name: ETH Price Feed
description: Real-time ETH price and 24h market data. No API key needed. Use standalone or chain into DeFi flows.

get_price.description: Fetch the current price, 24h change, and market direction for ETH or any major asset.

permissions.reason: CoinGecko public API for live price data

asset.description: CoinGecko asset ID. Default: ethereum. Others: bitcoin, arbitrum, usd-coin

change_24h.description: 24h price change as a percentage e.g. -8.2

direction.description: up / down / flat — based on 24h change

last_updated.description: Unix timestamp of the price data
